title: Perch Gallery Category Parent Tile
description: Parent tile entry stored as <foldername>.yaml inside each category folder. Provides display metadata (name, sort, pattern) that replaces the retired catalog/categories.yaml.

name.description: Display name for this category (e.g. '.NET', 'IDEs & Editors')

sort.description: Sort order relative to siblings (lower first)

pattern.description: UI pattern. Set on top-level categories; subcategories inherit.

description.description: Optional short description shown on the category tile
